answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops fake identities. A new identity deposits 60 credits in a vault, locked 20 epochs, and stays inactive until it makes exchanges with 12 distinct, independent counterparties. A walnut grower in a grove counts as one counterparty only, and closed-circle trades do not count. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 relationships plus 60,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 60 once and earns undiluted rewards.
